I prefer to study for a short time every day. First, it is easier to fit a short lesson into my schedule. For example, I can practice listening for ten minutes after dinner, even on a busy day. Second, daily practice helps me remember new expressions. If I learn a phrase on Monday and use it again on Tuesday, it becomes more familiar. A long weekly session can be useful for a practice test, but I may feel tired and lose concentration. For these reasons, I would choose short daily lessons and add an occasional longer session when I have more time.
